item.tib: rig 'dzin sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dpe rtsis dang rgyud rim zla 'od gzhon nu'i 'khri shing
item.coloph: ces sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa rig 'dzin gsang ba'i rgyud kyi dpe rtsis dang brgyud (rgyud) rim zla 'od gzhon nu'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don grub ces pa sa mo lug gi lor rnam mkhyen ston pa 'chi med gtsug phud kyi bar lha 'od gsal gnas su spyan 'dren g.yung drung sems dpa' bcu gsum phyir mi ldog sa la bkod pa'i dus chen ston zla 'bring po'i tshes bzang por gyim shod shel brag mngon dga'i tshal du/ mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grag pa'am o rgyan bde chen gling pa bdag gis legs par bgyis shing / phyi mo 'phrul ni gdong rigs drung mu zu wer gyis dad brtson mos pa'i sgo nas sor mo'i zlos gar du bsgyur zhing gang zhig rnam dag legs byas kyi dge des mnyam med rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di phyogs dus gnas skabs kun du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
